trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. There is nothing extra to do for it beyond finishing everything else on this list, so treat it as your finish line rather than a task of its own. PowerPyx puts the whole run at roughly 200 hours and difficulty 4 out of 10, with the 100% checklist eating most of that time. The Insider Gaming list gives the same requirement: every other trophy first.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unlocked automatically when you finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission of Chapter 1. It cannot be missed, so just play the story and it pops on its own — no side objective, no collectible and no choice feed into it.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. It unlocks automatically at the chapter's end, so there is nothing to plan around. Before you leave Chapter 1, though, do the balcony meditation with Lucia — it is the one interaction PowerPyx flags as possibly missable for Positive Mental Attitude.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. It unlocks automatically when the chapter closes, and it cannot be missed. Chapter 2 is also when both characters can roam together, which opens up the partner trophies.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. Automatic and unmissable — it pops when the chapter ends. Keep an eye out for side content as it appears, but nothing in this chapter needs special trophy planning.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. Automatic and unmissable — it pops when the chapter closes. By this point you should have a manual save at each chapter boundary, since there is no mission replay and no New Game+, and the one missable trophy is already behind you if you meditated in Chapter 1.
trophies.name: Top of the World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing the final mission, which closes Chapter 5 and the campaign. It unlocks automatically and cannot be missed. Once it pops, free roam continues and the 100% Completion Checklist opens under Progress, which is when the real clean-up begins. The Insider Gaming list gives the same trigger: the final mission.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing the mission Breakfast Run, the first story mission of Stage 1. It unlocks automatically as part of the campaign and cannot be missed — there is no extra objective to complete and no choice to get wrong. Just play the mission through to its end and the trophy pops when it closes.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing the mission The Cartel Heist, a Stage 1 heist mission. Automatic and unmissable — it pops when the heist mission ends. Play it through like any story mission; no preparation and no side objective feed into the trophy.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing the mission Child's Play in Stage 1. Automatic and unmissable — just play the mission through to its end. Nothing you do before the mission changes it, and the trophy pops the moment the mission closes.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing the mission Headliners in Stage 1. Automatic and unmissable — it pops when the mission completes. Play the mission through; there is no hidden requirement and no way to lock yourself out of it.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing the mission VCIA Takedown in Stage 1. Automatic and unmissable — play the mission and the trophy follows when it ends. No extra step is needed before or during the mission.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy for completing the mission Operation Savage Glory in Stage 1. Automatic and unmissable — it pops when the mission ends. Just play it through; the trophy needs nothing beyond the mission itself.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set and the heart of the post-story clean-up. After the final mission, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion to see the checklist. PowerPyx notes the list is lenient — closer to 60% true completion — but it still demands a lot: 300 stunts, all 42 shooting-range gold medals, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 33 underwater discoveries, all robberies, and 70 of the 80 challenges. Budget around 100 hours for this stage alone. GameMapa ranks it the hardest trophy too, and lists the same 100% checklist.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Stunts are split across four types, and Push Square counts 397 in the game: 130 stunt jumps off ramps and bridges, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between tall buildings, and 25 base jumps. You need 250 of them for this trophy, but 300 for 100% completion, so keep going past the pop. Found stunt spots show on the map under Touch Pad, Exploration, Stunt Spots, and progress lives under Progress, Activities, Stunts. GameMapa lists the same target: 250 stunts, out of 397 spots in total.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: There are nine activity types to sample once each. PowerPyx lists them as fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. Just try one of each as you come across them — a single attempt counts, no win or score needed. GameMapa lists the same nine activity types, one try each.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: You need a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, across three difficulty tiers per challenge. The two ranges are Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero — find them under Touch Pad, Activities, Shooting Ranges. Some challenges stay locked until you meet their conditions, which the map shows. Track progress at the same menu. All 42 golds are also required for 100% completion. The EGamers list gives the same requirement for this trophy.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: There are 14 Top Fun drone race locations, and you must win at every one. Some charge an entry fee, so bring cash. Found locations show under Touch Pad, Activities, Drones, Top Fun Drones. All 14 wins are also part of the 100% checklist. The EGamers list gives the same requirement for this trophy.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: You must win 20 different races — winning the same race twice does not count. Race locations appear across Leonida as you explore, and you can track them under Touch Pad, Activities, Racing. Most locations let you hire a car; if you bring your own, watch its Rating and buy upgrades at Mod Shops first. The Insider Gaming list gives the same requirement: 20 different race wins.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Fairly early on, Cal asks you to catch a Parrotfish over 2kg. Fish in the marked area until you land one of a suitable size — the game shows the weight as you reel it in. You need a boat and a fishing rod; plenty of boats in the area can be borrowed if you do not own one.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Find an arcade cabinet in Leonida and finish one full game on it. Any arcade game counts — just play one through to its end and the trophy pops. Cabinets sit in bars and amusement spots around the map, so treat this as a quick stop between story missions rather than a grind.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's whole mission strand, ending with the final mission in the chain. Andy's quests are Lucia-only, per PowerPyx's roadmap notes, so play them as Lucia when they appear. The trophy pops when the last mission in the strand completes.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's whole mission strand. Push Square notes the final mission in the chain is called Maritime Disputes — complete it and the trophy pops. Do the strand as it appears rather than leaving it all for the end.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's whole mission strand. Push Square notes the final mission in the chain is called Hometown Heroes — complete it and the trophy pops. The strand runs across Stage 2, so work it alongside the other Strangers & Freaks strands rather than hunting it first.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Stranger missions are the question-mark encounters scattered across Leonida. You need to finish 8 full strands — not 8 single missions. PowerPyx notes only some side questlines count toward the eight, and it was still confirming exactly which ones when the guide was written, so work through every strand you find and keep count in the tracker. They can all be done after the story. The Insider Gaming list agrees on eight stranger strands.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's whole mission strand. Randy's chain revolves around his vehicle wish list — Push Square points to a list of Randy's Wish List vehicle locations to help you progress it. Complete the final mission in the strand and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's whole mission strand. Tyrone's quests are Jason-only, per PowerPyx's roadmap notes, so play them as Jason. Push Square points to a list of Kitty Litter Lab locations that helps you progress the chain. Complete the final mission and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Spin on This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: The only trophy any guide flags as possibly missable, so handle it with care. There are 18 meditation spots across Leonida, and you must complete a meditation at each — a spot only counts once the final zen animation has played. The risk is the first one: in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia invites you to meditate on the balcony at Jason's house. Do it before leaving Chapter 1, and keep a separate Chapter 1 save as insurance, because PowerPyx is still checking whether skipping it blocks the trophy. Track found spots on the map under Touch Pad, Exploration, Meditate Around Leonida, and progress under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. The last meditation cannot be done until you can play as both characters, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. The Insider Gaming list gives the same requirement for this trophy.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret's quests revolve around hunting specific animals. Complete the hunt he asks for and the trophy pops. Bret's quests are Jason-only, per PowerPyx's roadmap notes, and all of them are also required for 100% completion, so do not skip them.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: There are 18 sets of Collectible Cards hidden around Leonida. You need all the cards in any 3 sets for this trophy — but 15 sets are required for 100% completion, so it will come on the way if you chase A Long Road. Cards you collect can be sold at Pawn Shops and still count toward your progress. Track sets under Progress, Collections, Collectible Cards. GameMapa lists the same target: 3 complete sets, out of 18 in total.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK is the phone app — hold Up to open it — that scans landmarks for extra information. Push Square breaks the scannable spots down as 31 WAiNK landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags. Scan any 100 of them and the trophy pops. Track progress under Progress, Collections, WAiNK Locations. GameMapa lists the same target: 100 WAiNK locations.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Challenges are the game's in-game achievement-style objectives — there are 80 of them in eight groups of ten. You need 50 for this trophy, and 70 for 100% completion, so you can skip the ten hardest ones. View every challenge and its requirement under Touch Pad, Progress, Challenges. The EGamers list gives the same requirement: 50 challenges finished.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Get a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops and escape. It only counts with your partner along, and it becomes possible once both characters can roam together in Chapter 2. Bank jobs hand out 4 stars anyway, so this often pops naturally during a robbery.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner along, rob three shops in a row without the wanted level dropping between them. Plan a route with three close shops, keep the heat on, and do not let the cops lose you mid-chain — if the wanted level clears, the chain resets and you start again.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: A vehicle counts as discovered when you get inside one or scan one. You need 100 different vehicles, which should happen naturally across a story playthrough as you drive, steal and scan. Track which ones you have found under Touch Pad, Progress, Vehicles. PowerPyx notes the 100% checklist asks for 200 of 277 base-model vehicle scans, so keep scanning past this pop. GameMapa lists the same target: 100 vehicles discovered.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus and take down five enemies before it ends. Pick a busy firefight with clustered enemies — a gang shootout or a police standoff — so five targets are in reach within one use. One clean run is all it takes.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Head to Vice City International Airport and leave by air without a scheduled flight — steal a plane and take off. Any aircraft at VCIA works: get into one on the apron, taxi onto the runway, build speed and lift off. There is no destination to reach and no flight plan to file; the trophy pops the moment your wheels leave the ground. If the first plane you find is locked or guarded, try another spot on the apron — any aircraft counts, and the airport is big enough that a quiet corner is never far away.
trophies.name: Catch Me if You Can

trophies.guide: Get behind the wheel of a Rhino tank and cause some chaos. The description is deliberately vague, so the practical read is: steal or find a Rhino, drive it, and the trophy pops once you have spent time raising hell in it. No guide had pinned down an exact trigger at launch, so if it does not pop immediately, keep driving and firing until it does.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Pick a jewelry store and rob it clean without tripping an alarm or being spotted. Go in quiet — mask up, move slowly, avoid cameras and staff sightlines — and get out before anyone raises the alarm. If you are detected, leave and try another store.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape each time. Bank vault robberies are part of the robbery side content, and PowerPyx counts eight bank vault robberies in the 100% checklist, so this trophy comes on the way to A Long Road. Plan your escape route before you go in — the getaway is half the job. The Insider Gaming list gives the same requirement: 5 bank vaults, then escape.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Find an armored truck on the road, rob it, and escape with the cops off your tail. Trucks spawn around the map — ambush one, crack it open, grab the cash, and lose your wanted level to pop the trophy.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Visit every region of the state of Leonida. There is no checklist in the trophy itself, so the practical approach is to drive or fly through every named area on the map — Vice City, the Keys, the swamps, the northern towns — until the map is fully revealed. It pops once the last area registers.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Every gang in Leonida runs illegal operations — fronts you can hit. Rob one operation for each gang and the trophy pops. These are part of the robbery side content, and PowerPyx counts 39 gang operations in the 100% checklist, so work through them methodically and note which gangs you have covered.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Head to Ocean Beach, find a bar with a view of the water, and order a cocktail. Sit, drink, enjoy the view — the trophy pops once the drink is served. It is a small moment trophy, so do it when you are passing through Vice Beach.
trophies.name: In the Beginning...

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Find a vehicle showroom, get a car inside it, and smash your way out through the glass in classic GTA style. Drive straight through the storefront and the trophy pops. Pick a showroom with a big front window and a fast car.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a full game with a proper follow-through. Finish the game and the trophy pops. It pairs naturally with Ten Pin if you are already at the lanes.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: The description is deliberately vague and no guide had pinned down the exact trigger at launch — it reads as a partnership milestone, likely tied to doing activities together as Jason and Lucia. Play co-op activities with your partner across Leonida and check the tracker; if it has not popped by the end of the story, keep working through partner activities in free roam.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: The description is deliberately vague and no guide had pinned down the exact trigger at launch — it reads as a story-choice trophy, tied to a decision you make during the campaign. Play the story naturally and make the choices that feel right; the trophy pops when the choice registers. If it has not popped by the final mission, it is worth checking the usual choice points in a chapter save.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: The description is deliberately vague and no guide had pinned down the exact trigger at launch — the name suggests retrying something that failed the first time. If an activity, race or mission goes wrong, try it again right away rather than moving on; the trophy likely pops on a successful second attempt. Keep this in mind whenever something fails and you retry it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: The description is deliberately vague and KeenGamer lists this one as unconfirmed at launch — no guide had pinned down the exact trigger. The name suggests a random world event or an unexpected encounter somewhere in Leonida. Explore widely, chase anything strange the game throws at you, and it should pop when the event fires.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: At the bowling alley, perform a melee drive-by — attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon and bowl someone over. KeenGamer lists this one as unconfirmed at launch, so the exact setup is still being worked out by players; the practical approach is to drive past a pedestrian near the lanes and swing a melee weapon from the vehicle. Pair it with a visit for Let's Go Bowling.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked Bills are dirty cash you pick up from robberies and other jobs. Launder them through your contacts until $250,000 has been cleaned in total — the counter is cumulative, so it adds up across the whole playthrough. Keep laundering after every big score rather than letting marked cash pile up. The Insider Gaming list gives the same figure: $250,000 laundered.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Simply spend $100,000 in total across any shops in Leonida. Push Square calls it the easiest trophy in the game — clothes, weapons, car mods and property purchases all count toward the total. Find shops on the map under Touch Pad, Style, and spend as you go. GameMapa lists the same requirement for this trophy.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone. Push Square lists them as Mitchel Auto Center ($4,000), 7th Avenue Garage ($12,000), Vela Rota Drive Garage ($24,000), Persistence Road Garage ($7,600), Wyatt Motors ($21,600), Bonita Court Garage ($34,000), Atlantic Court Garage ($40,000) and Store n' Bolt ($16,800) — $160,000 in total. Each garage adds one parking spot, and registered vehicles can be called in with Scooter Bros. The EGamers list gives the same requirement for this trophy.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 different vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Drive any vehicle to a Pay 'N' Spray or Mod Shop and register it there — you need a free parking spot, so buy garages first if you are full. The fee varies with the vehicle's value. Once registered, Scooter Bros delivers the repaired vehicle to you for a small fee. Register 10 different vehicles and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: On the Spot
